owned_child.routing: owned child(native-1) -> operator 192.168.100.170:42499 (own frame proxy) -> repair hub :18080

owner_reference.note: owned child Agent uses the exact repair Agent binary; process owner is the harness on native-1, never a nodesteer-agent*.service unit

sampler.note: the sampler runs ON the node (same kernel clock as the journal); it samples at ~1ms and records the first moment the execution row is visible in the Agent store and the first moment the script has run its first statement

outage.note: stop the ONE authorised repair unit while the real execution is still running

outage_probe.probe: no HTTP answer AND TCP connect to :18080 refused

during_outage.note: the process kept producing output and the Agent kept the journal locally with synced=0 while the Hub did not exist

seam.note: EXECUTION_ACK was withheld on the harness-owned frame proxy, so the Agent kept the journal row at synced=0 (its own product invariant) while the Hub already had the terminal row; a real link cut + reconnect then triggered the product re-upload path (reconcileExecutions).

cpu.model: Intel Core Processor (Haswell, no TSX, IBRS)
